title: Scenes: CAD and line views side by side, and slope-corrected gravity inputs
summary: The Scene page shows the CAD view, the Runs page's line drawing, or both side by side, and records whichever it shows. A scene robot's slope_inputs option estimates the ground's pitch along the robot whenever a front and a rear leg touch the ground (their toes' height difference over their distance, smoothed over about 0.1 s and limited to 20 degrees) and gives the policy gravity relative to that ground in all five history frames. With destination_v29 on the surrogate, the estimate matches 3.8, 6.7 and 9.5 degree ramps, but the correction changes no outcome: at 0.1 m/s both versions climb 4 and 7 degree ramps on schedule and stall at the crest of a 9 degree ramp, and at 0.15 m/s both stall at the foot of 9 and 14 degree ramps.
next: Look at foot clearance and the swing height at a ramp's foot and crest, where the blind policy stalls, before training on slopes.
reason: Scene tooling only; training, the canonical task, reward and evaluator are unchanged.
